d:
Hey guys, welcome to my newest comic, Pretty Pictures! This is another corruption focused comic revolving around a girl from the countryside with the dreams of becoming a fashion model in the big city. As always, the comic will be updated for the general public in 1080p, but bronze tier members to my patreon will get the chapters early. The twist for this comic is that silver+ tiered members get to vote on how the story plays out at the end of every chapter! Hopefully you guys enjoy it and I'd love to hear your feedback!

Part 3 of the comic is out now for patreon members now and voting is open!

Here is the Album for this comic: https://lensdump.com/a/wHt6K/sub Once you click into a chapter, you can use the "oldest" or the "A-Z" buttons to sort the pages properly.

Please consider supporting me on Patreon if you enjoy my work!

https://www.patreon.com/Antalore42

If you have any questions or suggestions, please leave them in the comments! Thank you!
